findings.title: Fast Pace Health permanently closes Princeton urgent-care clinic on October 23
findings.exact_supporting_passage: A staff member at the clinic confirmed the facility will permanently close at 6:00 p.m. Friday, October 23.
findings.access_consequences: The Princeton clinic was slated to close permanently at 6:00 p.m. CDT (4:00 p.m. PDT) October 23, eliminating this location's seven-day extended-hours walk-in urgent care, on-site X-ray and lab access. Local staff pointed patients to Fast Pace clinics in Hopkinsville and Madisonville. Closure is staff-confirmed by local reporting; no independent post-closing operational verification was available.
findings.affected_population: Princeton and surrounding Caldwell County residents seeking urgent, non-life-threatening illness or injury care; exact patient census and alternate local capacity unknown.
